items.evidence: python roll.py --ticks N [--inputs] [--board 1|2|3] [--settings DIR] printed one JSON object with tick, screen, board, score, lives, ball, coins, crates, bridge_x, volume, language, selected, texts, sounds (e.g. --ticks 10: screen title, selected Start, texts [Roll, Start, Settings, Quit]).
roll.py ... --frame X.png --size 800x480 wrote 14 frames (play boards 1-3, title, settings, paused, won, lost); each has a PNG signature and an 800x480 IHDR.
work/sounds/{coin,bounce,fall,clear}.wav (README): 48 kHz mono 16-bit, lasting 0.30/0.25/0.90/0.80 s, peaks 0.75-0.89, rms 0.15-0.18, zero crossings 2480/216/387/1278 per s, all md5 different.
Title at tick 5: selected Start. menu_down gives Settings, then Quit; menu_up goes back to Settings. 1:enter gives screen play, board 1, score 0, lives 3, texts [Board 1 of 3, Score: 0, Lives: 3].
Settings: Volume: 8, Language: English. 3x menu_right gives volume 10 (capped), 10x menu_left gives 0. On Language, menu_right gives es and menu_left gives en. Back+enter returns to the title.

With es: title [Roll, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir]; settings [Ajustes, Volumen: 8, Idioma: Espanol, Volver]; play [Tablero 2 de 3, Puntos: 0, Vidas: 3]; paused [En pausa, Continuar, Salir al titulo]; won [Has ganado, Puntos: 30, Pulsa Intro...]; lost [Fin del juego, ...]. No English left (Roll is the name).

Run 1 with --settings judge-scratch/set1 set volume 5 and es. Run 2 with the same folder started at volume 5, es, Spanish texts. A run without the folder started at 8, en. A later change back to en was also kept.
0:enter (play from tick 1), per-tick trace: first y<=0.3 at tick 28 (play tick 27); y back above 0.3 at tick 31; from tick 81 to tick 620, y=0.2499; sounds [bounce, bounce].
On board 1, 30 ticks of right/left/up/down moved the ball +x/-x/-z/+z by 0.359. With no input for the next 40 ticks it kept moving 0.024 per tick the same way.

My controller over --follow took the 4 coins: each gave +10, removed that coin and added coin. At tick 511 (the 4th coin) board=2, clear was added, ball (-3,1.25,0) at rest, board 2's 3 coins listed, but crates was [] (empty). The six crates first appear at tick 512, so the state that changes board does not hold board 2's crates.
0:board2+enter, no input, traced ticks 1-400: all six crates stayed within 0.0007 of (0, 0.25/0.75, -0.5/0/0.5).

Board 2 with right held from tick 1: the middle column (2 crates) was pushed to x=1.69 by tick 301 (>0.3); the others stayed. The ball reached x=1 at about tick 290, against about 110 ticks on an open board (b1: +2.5 m in 77 ticks). No crate went below y=0.2 while over the board.
Same run kept going: the two pushed crates went off x=4 and fell. The one at y=-4.87 (t498) is gone at t499, the one at -4.99 (t502) is gone at t503. The other 4 stayed at their places.

Board 1, left held: lives 3 to 2, fall added, ball reset to (0,1.25,0) and then falling from rest, the 2 coins taken stayed taken. After clearing board 1 the run went to board 2 with lives 2. On board 2 a fall left the crates unmoved and the taken coin gone.
0:board3+enter, no input: bridge_x at board ticks 90/180/270/360 = 1, 2, 1, 0 exactly; again 1, 2, 1, 0 at 450/540/630/720.

I steered the ball onto the bridge and left it there 180 ticks with no input: max |ball.x - bridge_x| = 0.289, y 0.2499 all along, lives 3. Pushed right off slab A at bt 140 (bridge at about 1.6-2): it fell in the gap, lost a life at t581, sound fall.

Script judge-scratch/b3win_clean.txt (single words only) with roll.py --board 3: at t670 screen won, score 30, coins []. At t700 and after right/left pushes the state is the same (ball, bridge_x). An enter at 740 gave the title.

After the 3rd fall (board 2, t1970): screen lost, lives 0, score 40. 150 more ticks with right/left/up/down/none left score, ball, coins, crates, lives unchanged. Enter gave the title (selected Start).

Board 3, escape at 100: at t300 screen paused, ball and bridge_x the same as t100 even with left held. Board 2 after the strike: escape at 250, at 450 ball/crates the same. enter (Resume) at 300 gave play and things moved again. menu_down+enter (Quit to title) gave the title.

roll.py --ticks 400 --board 2 --inputs 1:right run twice: the outputs are byte-identical (cmp), crates pushed to x=3.70 included. The board 3 win script also replayed exactly the same as the --follow session.

f_b2.png: perspective from above/+z showing the whole board; ball shaded at x=0.57 next to the pushed pair at x=1.05; 4 crates at x=0 with lighter tops/darker fronts; 3 coins. f_b3.png: 2 slabs, gap, green bridge at about x=1.67 matching bridge_x.

Frames looked at: title/settings/paused/won/lost in Spanish show the Spanish texts (En pausa, Has ganado, Fin del juego...). Play frames show 'Board 2 of 3 Score: 0 Lives: 3' / 'Tablero 2 de 3 Puntos: 0 Vidas: 3'.

Could not hear or measure the sound headless. The game code calls cx.sound(name, None, 1.0) with a fixed gain. Only README line 72 says it is played with the volume's gain; it does not show where, and the engine does the scaling (notes/how.md).
README gives how to play, working commands for the headless run (roll.py), the frame (--frame) and the WAVs (sounds/), which file holds what, and what was checked.

defects: After a board is cleared, the state on the tick of the change reports crates as [] although board 2 has six crates (one tick late).
A push of 4 m/s2 moves the rolling ball only at about 2.86 m/s2 (0.359 m in 0.5 s, against 0.5 m expected).
Settings texts also list the title's texts (Roll, Start, Settings, Quit) under the settings ones.
The ball does not topple the crates: the struck column of two slides as a block.
The bridge in the board-3 frame is drawn with a notch on its left side.
After Quit to title, the state still reports board, score, lives, ball and crates instead of null.
could_not_check: m23: whether nothing is heard at volume 0 cannot be observed in a headless run, and neither the README nor the game code shows where the volume scales the sound.
